title: 第一卷 第11章 做好准备！
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这一天果然没让沈鹿溪等太久。

张媒婆走了没几天，王桂花就把沈大山叫到了正房。

沈鹿溪当时在院子里劈柴，听见正房里传出王桂花的声音，不高不低，刚好能飘到院子里。

“老二，你闺女的亲事我给她定了。镇上的周员外，家里有田有铺子，你闺女嫁过去就是享福的。”

嫁过去？说的倒好听。

五十多岁的老头子，家里已经有三房妾了，买个十四岁的丫头回去当小妾，这叫享福？

沈大山的声音闷闷的：“娘，鹿溪才十四......”

“十四怎么了？村里多少姑娘十四就定亲了？周员外给了二十两银子的聘礼，二十两！你种一辈子地也攒不出这个数！”

赵翠屏在旁边帮腔：“就是啊二弟，这么好的亲事打灯笼都找不着，你还挑三拣四的。”

沈大山沉默了。

沈鹿溪把柴刀插在木墩上，拍了拍手上的木屑，走到正房门口

“爹，出来一下。”

这话一出屋里的人都看了过来。

王桂花脸一沉：“大人说话，你一个小孩插什么嘴！滚出去！”

沈鹿溪没理她，只看着沈大山：“爹，出来。”

沈大山犹豫了一下，站起来跟着走了出去。

王桂花在后面骂了两句，沈鹿溪充耳不闻，把沈大山拉到自家屋里，关好了门。

柳荞娘也在屋里，脸色已经白了。

“鹿溪，你奶奶她......”

“我都听到了。”沈鹿溪看着沈大山，“爹，你答应了没有？”

沈大山低着头，半天没吭声。

“爹。”沈鹿溪加重了语气，“你答应了没有？”

“......没有。”沈大山声音很小，“我没答应，可你奶奶她......”

“她说什么不重要。”沈鹿溪打断他，“爹，你是我亲爹，这个家你说了不算难道奶奶说了就算？她要卖我你拦不拦？”

沈大山抬起头，嘴唇哆嗦了一下。

他这辈子被王桂花压了几十年，从来没顶过嘴，没反抗过。

可闺女这么直愣愣的看着他，眼睛里没有怨恨，只有这一个问题。

“拦。”沈大山攥紧了拳头，“爹拦。”

沈鹿溪松了口气。

“好。爹，接下来的事你就听我安排。”

她把计划简短地说了一遍，最后说道，“现在就差一个时机。”

“什么时机？”沈大山问。

Page (1/3)

As expected, Shen Luxi didn't have to wait too long for this day.

A few days after Matchmaker Zhang left, Wang Guihua called Shen Dashan to the main room.

Shen Luxi was chopping firewood in the yard when he heard Wang Guihua's voice coming from the main room. It was neither high nor low, just enough to float into the yard.

"Second brother, I have arranged your daughter's marriage. She is a member of the Zhou family in the town, and her family has land and a shop. Your daughter will be blessed if she marries her."

Get married?That sounds nice.

An old man in his fifties already has three concubines at home. If he buys a 14-year-old girl to be his concubine, is this called enjoyment?

Shen Dashan's voice was muffled: "Mom, Luxi is only fourteen..."

"What happened to fourteen? How many girls in the village got engaged at fourteen? Yuanwai Zhou gave me a betrothal gift of twenty taels of silver, twenty taels! You can't save this amount in your whole life!"

Zhao Cuiping supported from the side: "That's right, second brother, you can't find such a good match even with all the lanterns, and you're still so picky."

Shen Dashan was silent.

Shen Luxi stuck the hatchet on the wooden pier, patted the sawdust on his hands, and walked to the door of the main house.

"Dad, come out."

As soon as these words came out, everyone in the room looked over.

Wang Guihua's face sank: "When adults are talking, why are you, a child, interrupting! Get out!"

Shen Luxi ignored her and only looked at Shen Dashan: "Dad, come out."

Shen Dashan hesitated for a moment, then stood up and walked out.

Wang Guihua cursed a few words from behind, but Shen Luxi turned a deaf ear and pulled Shen Dashan into his house and closed the door.

Liu Qiaoniang was also in the room, her face already pale.

"Lu Xi, your grandma..."

"I heard everything." Shen Luxi looked at Shen Dashan, "Dad, have you agreed?"

Shen Dashan lowered his head and said nothing for a long time.

"Dad." Shen Luxi emphasized his tone, "Have you agreed?"

"...No." Shen Dashan's voice was very low, "I didn't agree, but your grandma..."

"It doesn't matter what she said." Shen Luxi interrupted him, "Dad, you are my biological father. What you say about this family does not count. Doesn't it matter what grandma says? If she wants to sell me, will you stop her?"

Shen Dashan raised his head and his lips trembled.

He has been suppressed by Wang Guihua for decades in his life, and he has never spoken back or resisted.

But the girl looked at him blankly, with no resentment in her eyes, only this question.

"Stop it." Shen Dashan clenched his fists, "Father, stop it."

Shen Luxi breathed a sigh of relief.

"Okay. Dad, you will follow my arrangements for the rest."

She briefly stated her plan and finally said, "There is only one moment left."

"What time?" Shen Dashan asked.
